## Use this capability when the user means

- fantasy football start sit help
- fantasy waiver decision

## Authority

public offer discovery and human-confirmed one-run purchase; entitlement exists only after authoritative payment verification

## Commercial state

- Status: payment_runtime_verified
- Payment state: Explicit user confirmation and authoritative completed-payment verification required

## Boundaries

- one purchased run entitlement is created per completed payment
- an unpaid checkout creates no entitlement
- fantasy recommendations can change as current NFL context changes
- referral attribution identifies acquisition source only and never proves checkout or payment
